Overview

Iquique is a city in TA with a population of 200,000. A coastal city famous for its duty-free port, historic quarter, and world-class paragliding and surfing. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year.
